# Matthew Cuthbert

## Overview

- **Age:** Sixty years old at the beginning of the series, passing away four years later at sixty-four.  <sub>[v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003), [v1 c25 P28](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0028), [v1 c25 P61](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0061)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002)</sub>
- **Status:** Deceased  <sub>[v1 c37 P9](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0009)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea, Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006), [v1 c2 P2](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0002)</sub>
- **Role:** Farmer  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Rachel Lynde's husband  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002)</sub>

## Appearance

Matthew Cuthbert is an odd-looking man with an ungainly, stooping figure. He wears long iron-gray hair reaching to his shoulders and has maintained a full, soft brown beard since his twenties.

_Sources: [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003)_

## Personality

Matthew is exceptionally shy, quiet, and silent, dreading strangers and particularly all women except his sister Marilla and Mrs. Rachel Lynde. He is a sympathetic, indulgent, and gentle soul who enjoys listening to talkative people without needing to converse himself. Despite his meek demeanor, he displays a quiet, dogged persistence when he sets his mind on a desire.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c1 P4](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0004), [v1 c1 P27](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0027), [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003), [v1 c2 P27](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0027), [v1 c4 P21](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0021), [v1 c4 P26](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0026), [v1 c19 P23](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0023), [v1 c24 P17](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0017)_

## Goals

- To adopt a native-born orphan boy to help him with farm work in his elder years  <sub>[v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023)</sub>
- To ensure Anne Shirley is kept, loved, and given a good upbringing and education  <sub>[v1 c3 P60](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0060), [v1 c6 P35](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0035), [v1 c25 P60](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0060)</sub>

## History

Matthew Cuthbert and his sister Marilla decide to adopt an orphan boy to help on their farm at Green Gables. Driving to Bright River station to collect the boy, Matthew instead finds Anne Shirley, an imaginative orphan girl sent by mistake. Too kind-hearted to leave her behind, he brings her to Green Gables and immediately takes a liking to her, quietly persuading Marilla to keep her. Over the years, Matthew becomes Anne's constant confidant and champion, encouraging her imaginative spirit and secretly buying her a fashionable dress with puffed sleeves for Christmas. When Anne passes her college entrance exams with distinction, Matthew expresses his deep pride in her. Shortly after Anne finishes her studies at Queen's Academy, Matthew dies instantly from a heart attack caused by the shock of the Abbey Bank's failure, and is buried in the Avonlea graveyard.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c2 P4](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0004), [v1 c2 P17](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0017), [v1 c3 P60](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0060), [v1 c6 P31](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0031), [v1 c10 P17](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0017), [v1 c25 P4](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0004), [v1 c25 P35](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0035), [v1 c36 P41](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0041), [v1 c37 P9](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0009), [v1 c37 P21](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0021)_

## Background by volume

- Raised in Avonlea at Green Gables, built by his father at the furthest edge of their cleared land  <sub>[v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006)</sub>
- Sufferer of heart trouble that limits his physical spruceness  <sub>[v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c30 P38](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0038), [v1 c36 P28](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0028)</sub>
- Lived his entire adult life at Green Gables alongside his sister Marilla  <sub>[v1 c1 P7](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0007), [v1 c1 P31](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0031)</sub>
